TaskDescription: Bilateral change-detection task: participants were cued to one hemifield, encoded the colors of 2 or 3 squares (unrepeated or repeated colors, with strong or weak spatial proximity), and after a 1 s retention interval reported whether a single-item probe had changed color.

BioSemi on-board decimation filter.Type: fifth-order sinc low-pass (DC-coupled amplifier, no hardware high-pass)

EEGReference: CMS/DRL (BioSemi Common Mode Sense and Driven Right Leg active electrodes) during recording; re-referenced offline to the average of the left and right mastoids
EEGGround: BioSemi CMS/DRL feedback loop (no separate ground electrode)
SubjectArtefactDescription: Participants were instructed to minimize head and eye movements.
